phase3_findings.description: No issues at confidence >= 80. Verified fail-closed reap logic across all path shapes, no orphaned consumer of the retired env var, no containment leak, and lib/normalize-path.sh ships via the vendor slice. Recommends approval.

The empty-_reap_base case arm (stop-refresher.sh:103) reaps nothing without its own breadcrumb; correct today (only reached via the source-failure else branch which already breadcrumbs) but defensively fragile if the normalizer ever returned empty for non-empty input.

dirname (non-preflight PATH tool) at stop-refresher.sh:92 decides the reap selection; fails CLOSED so acceptable per CLAUDE.md, but on a dirname-less host the breadcrumb misattributes the cause. Consider bash parameter expansion ${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}.

Stop-step comment third line ('GITHUB_RUN_ID/GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/GITHUB_JOB are available in every step.') is background justification rather than prevention content; block sits at the three-line cap. Not a falsehood. No documented_falsehood findings anywhere.

The 'reaps nothing / live orphan untouched' property is asserted for only 2 of 5 fail-closed shapes (UNC, unsourceable-normalizer); the three drive-letter-family arms assert only breadcrumb + exit 0. Low risk (all funnel into the same REAP_GLOB="" sink already proven).
No plain-POSIX derived-path positive reap control (only the converter-stub path plants a reapable orphan in the derived dir). Code path is covered indirectly; completeness nicety only.
HANDLE-equality pin asserts literal presence in each step ('1 1'), catching one-sided drift but brittle to an intentional joint refactor. Acceptable/arguably stronger for a machine-consumed boundary.

stop-refresher.sh now has a runtime dependency on lib/normalize-path.sh even on Linux; correct fail-closed today and the helper ships via vendor-slice, but a future prune would silently make the security-relevant orphan reaper inert. Suggests a retention-rationale note.
_stop_sh_guarded mirrored defaults in run.sh are a coupled site with stop-refresher.sh's defaults, guarded only by a comment; drift would silently check stale paths. Low risk.
